name: Shingū Shrine

depictions.name: Shingu Shrine
depictions.text: Shingu Shrine was a Shinto shrine south of Azuchi Castle in Ōmi, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the shrine while traveling through Azuchi.
